info.name: Warren Backend Challenge
info.description: Walk-through of every endpoint and outcome of the trading API, with assertions. Start from a fresh seed: `npm run db:reset` then `npm run dev`. Run the collection top to bottom (Collection Runner); it mutates the seed, so reset before a full run. `requests.http` is the canonical source; this is the Postman export of the same walk-through, with the idempotency replays and the repeated cancel made explicit.
